mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, we are enjoying clear skies and a comfortable 84 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School.

The City Clerk's office is currently hosting the I Voted sticker design contest. Verona students submitted 53 original designs, and residents are encouraged to vote for their favorite in each age category online through August 7 to decide what voters will receive this November.

We have plenty of fun on the calendar, starting with trivia at Hop Haus and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by a busy tomorrow featuring the downtown farmer's market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and more trivia at The Bogey Factory.
In our weekly police report, officers handled a variety of calls, including an arrest on Sunday of a 37-year-old Madison man for O W I.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Georgia Peach, and you can also catch the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park from 1:30 PM to 4:15 PM today.
